rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sense of dalal as error: in 4:176 it means making mistakes in dividing inheritance.
rows.anchor: يبين الله لكم ان تضلوا يعني أن تخطئوا في قسمة المواريث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sense of dalal as forgetting: in 2:282 'one of them errs' means one of them forgets.
rows.anchor: ان تضل احداهما يعني تنسى احداهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Dalal in its own sense (eighth): 6:125 cited; the author says examples of this sense are many.
rows.anchor: ومن يرد ان يضله يجعل صدره ضيقا حرجا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Atraf al-nahar in 20:130 means noon and afternoon prayer times.
rows.anchor: فسبح واطراف النهار يعني الظهر والعصر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In 11:114 the two ends of the day mean the dawn, noon and afternoon prayers.
rows.anchor: يعني صلاة الغداة والظهر والعصر

rows.speaker: unnamed (يقال)
rows.claim: An unnamed view: the phrase in 11:114 is the dawn prayer alone.
rows.anchor: ويقال صلاة الغداة الثاني الطرف باسكان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tarf (with sukun) as a thief of the eye; 42:45 'a stealthy glance' means glances that steal sight.
rows.anchor: ينظرون من طرف خفي يعني بسارق الاعين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qasirat al-tarf means women who lower their gaze, content with their husbands.
rows.anchor: قاصرات الطرف يعني غاضات العيون قانعات بازواجهن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tarf (with fath) as a group or party; 3:127 'to cut off a part' means to kill a party.
rows.anchor: ليقطع طرفا من الذين كفروا اي يقتل طائفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tariq as the road itself; 20:77 gives a dry path through the land.
rows.anchor: فاضرب لهم طريقا في الارض يبسا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tara'iq as the heavens; 23:17 'seven heavens' is the sense.
rows.anchor: ولقد خلقنا فوقكم يبع طرائق يعني سبع سموات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tara'iq as differing desires or factions; 72:11 means differing views.
rows.anchor: كنا طرائق قددا يعني اهواء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ta'am as food that people eat; 106:4 cited, with similar uses at 6:14, 76:8 and 33:53.
rows.anchor: فوجه منها الطعام الذي يأكله الناس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ta'am as the slaughtered meat of the People of the Book; 5:5 'their food is lawful for you'.
rows.anchor: يعني ذبائح أهل الكتاب مثلها فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ta'am as salted fish; 5:96 'game of the sea and its food' means salted fish.
rows.anchor: احل لكم ضيد البحر وطعامه متاعا لكم يعني مالحة منفعة لكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ta'am as drink; 2:249 'whoever does not taste it' means whoever does not drink it.
rows.anchor: يعني من لم يشربه فانه مني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: 5:93 'what they ate' means what they drank of wine before its prohibition.
rows.anchor: اي فيما شربوا من الخمر قبل التحريم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Root t-gh-y has four senses: error, disobedience, rising or abundance, and wrongdoing or lying.
rows.anchor: الضلال العصيان الارتفاع والكثرة والظلم والكذب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tughyan as error: 2:15 'in their transgression' means in their error.
rows.anchor: ويمدهم في طغيانهم يعمهون يعني في ضلالتهم يعمهون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tughyan as misleading: 50:27 'I did not make him transgress' means I did not mislead him.
rows.anchor: ربنا ما اطغيته اي ما اضللته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Taghin as astray: 37:30 'a people who were transgressors' means erring people.
rows.anchor: بل كنتم قوما طاغين اي ضالين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tughyan as disobedience: 20:24 on Pharaoh, 'he transgressed' means he disobeyed.
rows.anchor: اذهب الى فرعون انه طغى يعني انه عصى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: 20:81 'do not transgress therein' means do not disobey God regarding the manna and quail.
rows.anchor: ولا تطغوا فيه فيحل عليكم غضبي يعني ولا تعصوا الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tughyan as rising and abundance: 69:11 'when the water rose' means it rose and increased.
rows.anchor: انا لما طغى الماء حملناكم في الجارية يعني ارتفع وكثر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tughyan as wrongdoing or lying: 55:8 'do not transgress in the balance' means do not wrong or lie.
rows.anchor: الا تطغوا في الميزان اي لا تظلموا ولا تكذبوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Taghut has three senses: Satan, idols, and Kaʿb b. al-Ashraf.
rows.anchor: على ثلاثة اوجه الشيطان الاوثان كعب بن الاشراف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Taghut as Satan: 2:257 'disbelieve in the taghut' means Satan; similar at 4:76 and 5:60.
rows.anchor: فمن يكفر بالطاغوت يعني الشيطان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Taghut as idols: 39:17 'those who avoid the taghut from worshipping it' means idols; 16:36 is similar.
rows.anchor: والذين اجتنبوا الطاغوت ان يعبدوها يعني الاوثان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Taghut as Kaʿb b. al-Ashraf: 'their allies are the taghut' means Kaʿb; 4:51 is similar.
rows.anchor: اولياؤهم الطاغوت يعني كعب بن الاشرف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAzm as hazm (resolve): 31:17 'that is of the matters requiring resolve' means their realities.
rows.anchor: ان ذلك من عزم الامور يعني من عزم الامور وحقائقها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAzm as tahqiq (carrying out): 2:227 'if they resolve on divorce' means if they carry it out.
rows.anchor: وان عزموا الطلاق يعني وان حققوا الطلاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAsr as dahr (time): in 103:1 'by the ʿasr' means by the dahr; first of the three senses of ʿ-ṣ-r.
rows.anchor: والعصر ان الانسان لفي خسر يعني والدهر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAsr as pressing (taʿsir): 12:49 'and therein they press' is the sense of pressing.
rows.anchor: وعام فيه يغاث الناس وفيه يعصرون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Iʿsar as a violent wind, hot or cold: 2:266 'a whirlwind with fire' means a strong wind.
rows.anchor: فاصابها اعصار فيه نار فاحترقت يعني ريحا شديدة باردة او حارة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAsf as violent (qasif): 21:81 'the wind was violent' means a strong, violent wind.
rows.anchor: ولسليمان الريح عاصفة يعني قاصفة شديدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAsf as foliage (waraq): 55:12 'grain with its husks' means the foliage.
rows.anchor: والحب ذو العصف يعني الورق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: 105:5 'like eaten husk' is glossed as eaten foliage.
rows.anchor: فجعلهم كعصف ماكول يعني الورق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAzim as glorious or majestic: 2:255 'the Exalted, the Mighty' means great in His rank.
rows.anchor: وهو العلي العظيم يعني الجليل في قدره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAzim as severe: 2:7 'a great punishment' means a severe one.
rows.anchor: ولهم عذاب عظيم يعني شديدا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAzim as accepted: 37:107 'a great sacrifice' means an accepted one.
rows.anchor: وفديناه بذبح عظيم يعني متقبلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAzim as awesome or terrifying: 83:5 'a great day' means a terrifying day.
rows.anchor: ليوم عظيم يعني هائلا ونحوه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAzim as widespread: 12:28 'your guile is great' means it afflicts innocent and guilty alike.
rows.anchor: ان كيدكن عظيم يعني يصيب البرىء والسقيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAzim as heavy: 24:16 'this is a great slander' means a heavy one.
rows.anchor: هذا بهتان عظيم اي ثقيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAzim as chief: 43:31 'a great man of one of the two towns' means the great chief.
rows.anchor: من القريتين عظيم يعني الرئيس الكبير

rows.speaker: unnamed (قيل)
rows.claim: Unnamed view: the great man of 43:31 is al-Walid b. al-Mughira and Abu Masʿud al-Thaqafi.
rows.anchor: قيل يعنون بذلك الوليد بن المغيرة وابا مسعود الثقفي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAzim as good: 68:4 'great character' means good character.
rows.anchor: وانك لعلى خلق عظيم يعني الخلق الحسن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAzim as large in size: 64:15 'a great reward' means great in its magnitude.
rows.anchor: والله عنده اجر عظيم اي كبير في حجمه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAzim as noble: 38:67 'a great tidings' means the Qurʾan is a noble, honourable report.
rows.anchor: قل هو نبا عظيم يعني القران خبر شريف كريم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: 78:2 'the great tidings' means the noble report.
rows.anchor: عن النبا العظيم اي الخبر الشريف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAfw as surplus wealth: 2:219 'say: the surplus' means what is beyond need.
rows.anchor: يسالونك مذا ينفقون قل العفو يعني الفضل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: 7:199 'take the ʿafw' means take the surplus of their wealth.
rows.anchor: خذ العفو وامر بالمعروف يعني خذ الفضل من اموالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAfw as leaving or waiving: women waive half the dowry, or the one holding the marriage bond waives it.
rows.anchor: الا ان يعفون يعني الا ان يتركن نصف المهر لازواجهن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAfa as leaving: 2:187 'He forgave you' means He left you and did not punish you.
rows.anchor: فتاب عليكم وعفا عنكم اي ترككم فلم يعاقبكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAfw as leaving a wrong: 42:40 'whoever forgives and makes amends' means leaves a wrong and amends.
rows.anchor: فمن عفا واصلح يقول فمن ترك مظلمة واصلح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAfw as the act itself: 3:152 'God has forgiven them' is the same sense.
rows.anchor: للذين انهزموا في احد ولقد عفا الله عنهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAfw as the act itself: 9:43 'God forgave you' is the same sense.
rows.anchor: عفا الله عنك لما اذنت لهم يعني العفو بعينه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿUqba as gain (ghanima): 60:11 'you gained' from the wives who went over to the disbelievers.
rows.anchor: ازواجكم الى الكفارفعاقبتم يعني غنمتم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAqaba as fighting back: the second sense, glossed by 22:60 (retaliation in kind).
rows.anchor: الثاني عاقب اي قاتل قوله تعالى في سورة الحج

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Listed as the seventeenth: ʿUtba b. Abi Lahab is the insan of 'Abasa 80:24 (let him look at his food).
rows.anchor: والسابع عشر : عتبة بن أبي لهب . [ ومنه ] قوله تعالى في عبس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Eighteenth: ʿAdi b. Rabiʿa is the insan of al-Qiyama 75:3.
rows.anchor: والثامن عشر : عدي بن ربيعة . [ ومنه ] قوله تعالى في القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nineteenth: ʿUtba b. Rabiʿa is the insan of Hud 11:9; 17:83 is also quoted.
rows.anchor: والتاسع عشر : عتبة بن ربيعة . ومنه قوله تعالى في هود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Twentieth: Umayya b. Khalaf is the insan of al-Fajr 89:15; 89:23 is also quoted.
rows.anchor: والعشرون : أمية بن خلف . [ ومنه ] قوله تعالى في الفجر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Twenty-first: Ubayy b. Khalaf is the insan of al-Nahl 16:4; 19:67 and 36:77 are also quoted.
rows.anchor: والحادي والعشرون : أبي بن خلف . [ ومنه ] قوله تعالى في النحل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Twenty-second: al-Harith b. ʿAmr is the insan of al-Balad 90:4.
rows.anchor: والثاني والعشرون : الحارث بن عمرو . [ ومنه ] قوله تعالى في البلد

rows.speaker: unnamed (قيل)
rows.claim: Unnamed view: 90:4 was revealed about Kalda b. Asid.
rows.anchor: وقيل : نزلت في كلدة بن أسيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Twenty-third: Abu Hudhayfa b. ʿAbdullah is the insan of Yunus 10:12.
rows.anchor: والثالث والعشرون : أبو حذيفة بن عبد الله . ومنه قوله تعالى : في يونس

rows.speaker: unnamed (قيل)
rows.claim: Unnamed view: 10:12 was revealed about al-Walid b. al-Mughira.
rows.anchor: وقيل : نزلت في الوليد بن المغيرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Twenty-fourth: Abu Lahab (Abd al-ʿUzza) is the insan named in al-ʿAsr 103:2.
rows.anchor: والرابع والعشرون : أبو لهب بن عبد العزى بن عبد المطلب [ ومنه ] قوله تعالى في العصر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Twenty-fifth: the kafir is the insan of al-Zalzala 99:3.
rows.anchor: والخامس والعشرون : الكافر [ ومنه ] قوله تعالى في الزلزلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khusran is defined as naqs (diminution); in common usage it is the loss of part of the capital.
rows.anchor: الخسران : النقص . وهو في التعارف نقص جزء من رأس المال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khusran as diminution (naqs): 55:9 'do not diminish the balance'.
rows.anchor: وأقيموا الوزن بالقسط ولا تخسروا الميزان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: 83:3 'when they measure out to them, they diminish' is the same sense.
rows.anchor: وإذا كالوهم أو وزنوهم يخسرون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khusran as ghabn (deception, loss): 39:15 'who lost themselves and their families'.
rows.anchor: قل إن الخاسرين الذين خسروا أنفسهم وأهليهم يوم القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khusran as ʿajz (incapacity): 12:14 'if the wolf eats him, we would be losers'.
rows.anchor: قالوا لئن أكله الذئب ونحن عصبة إنا إذا لخاسرون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: 23:34 'if you obey a human like yourselves, you would be losers' is the same sense.
rows.anchor: ولئن أطعتم بشرا مثلكم إنكم إذا لخاسرون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khusran as dalal (error): 4:119 'he has lost a manifest loss'.
rows.anchor: والرابع : الضلال : ومنه قوله تعالى في سورة النساء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: 103:2 'mankind is indeed in loss' is cited as a similar case of the dalal sense, after 4:119.
rows.anchor: والعصر إن الإنسان لفي خسر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khusran as punishment (ʿuquba): 7:23 'we will surely be among the losers'.
rows.anchor: وإن لم تغفر لنا وترحمنا لنكونن من الخاسرين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: 11:47 'I would be among the losers' is cited in the punishment sense.
rows.anchor: والخامس : العقوبة . ومنه قوله تعالى في الأعراف
